value.rationale: This natural one-parameter conic foliation of an established rational system has a geometrically forced, sharp transition from two simple chart poles to one double chart pole and then no chart poles. The transition changes the entire stationary integrability range from q<1 to q<1/2 and then all finite q, while the two different singular crossover functions quantify the near-critical excursion distributions on both sides. The quantitative invariant-distribution question is motivated by orbit sampling in a map whose geometric carriers were previously classified; the calculation is more than redoing known orbit tables or an arbitrary finite slice. Its limitations (one explicit map and invariant carrier) are disclosed; no unproved downstream generality is claimed.
